Bug_Title: NP: Possible null pointer dereference in method on exception path (NP_NULL_ON_SOME_PATH_EXCEPTION)
Bug_Details:
A reference value which is null on some exception control path is
dereferenced here.  This may lead to a NullPointerException
when the code is executed. 
Note that because SpotBugs currently does not prune infeasible exception paths,
this may be a false warning.  Also note that SpotBugs considers the default case of a switch statement to
be an exception path, since the default case is often infeasible. NullPointerException
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by setting the'result' variable to null in the catch block. If an exception is thrown, the'result' remains null, and calling 'toLowerCase()' on it in the return statement leads to a NullPointerException.
Trigger_Explanation: The test method 'testShowBugWithException' calls the'showBug' method with the argument 'throw', which triggers an IllegalArgumentException inside the'showBug' method. As a result, the'result' variable remains null, and attempting to call 'toLowerCase()' on it in the return statement leads to a NullPointerException.
